events.zoro-vs-whisky-peak-bounty-hunters: Zoro single-handedly defeats Baroque Works' hundred bounty hunters.
events.luffy-vs-zoro-whisky-peak: A misunderstanding: Luffy and Zoro fight, with Luffy thinking Zoro has betrayed the townspeople.
events.luffy-zoro-vs-mr5-miss-valentine: Luffy and Zoro defeat Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine to protect Vivi.
events.vivi-reveals-crocodile: Vivi accidentally reveals that the boss of Baroque Works is Crocodile, one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea.
events.miss-all-sunday-debut: Nico Robin makes her first appearance as Miss All Sunday, Mr. 0's partner.
events.vivi-joins-straw-hats: The Straw Hats agree to escort Vivi and Karoo to Alabasta.
